description: This file defines an abstract base class for entity functions used in query conditions within the OFBiz framework. It includes implementations for common SQL functions like LENGTH, TRIM, UPPER, and LOWER, as well as mechanisms for handling nested functions and generating SQL syntax.

classes.name: EntityFunction
classes.description: Abstract base class for defining entity functions used in query conditions, supporting SQL functions like LENGTH, TRIM, UPPER, LOWER, and nested functions.

classes.name: EntityFunctionSingle
classes.description: Base class for entity functions that operate on a single value or nested function.

classes.name: EntityFunctionNested
classes.description: Base class for entity functions that operate on nested entity functions.

classes.name: LENGTH
classes.description: Represents the SQL LENGTH function applied to an entity condition value.

classes.name: TRIM
classes.description: Represents the SQL TRIM function applied to an entity condition value.

classes.name: UPPER
classes.description: Represents the SQL UPPER function applied to an entity condition value.

classes.name: LOWER
classes.description: Represents the SQL LOWER function applied to an entity condition value.

methods.name: length
methods.description: Creates a new LENGTH entity function with a given nested condition value or object.

methods.name: trim
methods.description: Creates a new TRIM entity function with a given nested condition value or object.

methods.name: upper
methods.description: Creates a new UPPER entity function with a given nested condition value or object.

methods.name: lower
methods.description: Creates a new LOWER entity function with a given nested condition value or object.
